sloka: न वाति पवनः शीतः न शशी सौम्य दर्शनः ।न सूर्यः तपते लोकम् सर्वम् पर्याकुलम् जगत् ॥२-४१-१८॥
transliteration: na vāti pavanaḥ śītaḥ na śaśī saumya darśanaḥ ।na sūryaḥ tapate lokam sarvam paryākulam jagat ॥2-41-18॥

translations.english: The breeze did not blow cool. No more did the Moon look pleasant. The Sun did not give warmth to the world. All the world was agitated.
